about:
FlowJo's gate grid, per event: expected membership for representative FlowJo polygons from the
three reference datasets (a FACSDiscover S8 file uncompensated, a FACSDiva and an LSRFortessa file
compensated; FlowJo 10.9.0 and 10.10.0), with each axis as the sample saved it and the vertices
rounded to 4 significant figures, on synthetic float32 events: both corners of every grid cell within
1.5 channels of the rounded outline, and events beyond both ends of each axis. Expected membership
comes from an independent numpy implementation of the rule (FlowJo's 4096-channel biex table with
the exact root; a 256-channel grid; on a linear or log axis events clamped to 0..255 and vertices
rounded and not clamped; on a biex axis events and vertices alike on the last table entry at or
below them, clamped to the table, so channels 0..256; a closed test on integers), which reproduced
FlowJo's own exported per-event membership with 0 disagreements in all 56 populations of those
datasets, and whose biex ends are those FlowRepository's counts decide (flowjoGrid.ts). events: x,y interleaved, float32 little-endian, base64;
membership: one bit per event, least significant first, base64.
